description: This file contains security-related utilities for password hashing and JSON Web Token (JWT) creation and decoding, including functions for verifying passwords, generating hashed passwords, creating access tokens with expiration, and decoding tokens. It interacts with external configuration and cryptography libraries.

methods.name: bool verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str)
methods.description: Verifies a plain password against its hashed version using bcrypt.

methods.name: str get_password_hash(password: str)
methods.description: Hashes a plain text password using bcrypt.

methods.name: str create_access_token(subject: str | int, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None, extra_claims: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT access token with optional expiration and extra claims.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] decode_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT, returning its payload if valid.

ctags.name: create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_access_token(subject: str | int, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None, extra_claims:/
ctags.signature: (subject: str | int, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None, extra_claims: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None)
